newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore Dec container throughput up 1.37 pct.
newsitem.headline: Singapore Dec container throughput up 1.37 pct.

text.p: The Port of Singapore Authority (PSA) said on Wednesday that December container throughput rose to 1.114 million TEU (twenty-foot equivalent units), up 1.37 percent from November.
The PSA said in its latest monthly report that container throughput registered for November was 1.099 million TEU.
Total cargo tonnage moving through Singapore in December also rose to 26,747 million tonnes from November's 25,827 million tonnes, it said.
In December, 10,277 vessels called at the port, compared with 10,083 in November.
Bunker fuel sales for 380-centistoke fuel oil was 840,000 tonnes in December, up from 652,000 tonnes in November.
The 180-centistoke fuel oil sales were 346,000 tonnes, also up from November's 341,000 tonnes.
